en.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
“Behold, I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

zhSimplified.text: 「看哪，犹大支派中，户珥的孙子、乌利的儿子比撒列，我已经提他的名召他。

zhTraditional.text: 「看哪，猶大支派中，戶珥的孫子、烏利的兒子比撒列，我已經提他的名召他。

en.text: I have filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship,

zhSimplified.text: 我也以我的灵充满了他，使他有智慧，有聪明，有知识，能做各样的工，

zhTraditional.text: 我也以我的靈充滿了他，使他有智慧，有聰明，有知識，能做各樣的工，

en.text: to devise skillful works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in bronze,

zhSimplified.text: 能想出巧工，用金、银、铜制造各物，

zhTraditional.text: 能想出巧工，用金、銀、銅製造各物，

en.text: and in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of workmanship.

zhSimplified.text: 又能刻宝石，可以镶嵌，能雕刻木头，能做各样的工。

zhTraditional.text: 又能刻寶石，可以鑲嵌，能雕刻木頭，能做各樣的工。

en.text: Behold, I myself have appointed with him Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the heart of all who are wise-hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded you:

zhSimplified.text: 我分派但支派中、亚希撒抹的儿子亚何利亚伯与他同工。凡心里有智慧的，我更使他们有智慧，能做我一切所吩咐的，

zhTraditional.text: 我分派但支派中、亞希撒抹的兒子亞何利亞伯與他同工。凡心裏有智慧的，我更使他們有智慧，能做我一切所吩咐的，

en.text: the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant, the mercy seat that is on it, all the furniture of the Tent,

zhSimplified.text: 就是会幕和法柜，并其上的施恩座，与会幕中一切的器具，

zhTraditional.text: 就是會幕和法櫃，並其上的施恩座，與會幕中一切的器具，

en.text: the table and its vessels, the pure lamp stand with all its vessels, the altar of incense,

zhSimplified.text: 桌子和桌子的器具，精金的灯台和灯台的一切器具并香坛，

zhTraditional.text: 桌子和桌子的器具，精金的燈臺和燈臺的一切器具並香壇，

en.text: the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, the basin and its base,

zhSimplified.text: 燔祭坛和坛的一切器具，并洗濯盆与盆座，

zhTraditional.text: 燔祭壇和壇的一切器具，並洗濯盆與盆座，

en.text: the finely worked garments—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, the garments of his sons to minister in the priest’s office—

zhSimplified.text: 精工做的礼服，和祭司亚伦并他儿子用以供祭司职分的圣衣，

zhTraditional.text: 精工做的禮服，和祭司亞倫並他兒子用以供祭司職分的聖衣，

en.text: the anointing oil, and the incense of sweet spices for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded you they shall do.”

zhSimplified.text: 膏油和为圣所用馨香的香料。他们都要照我一切所吩咐的去做。」

zhTraditional.text: 膏油和為聖所用馨香的香料。他們都要照我一切所吩咐的去做。」

en.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

“Speak also to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Most certainly you shall keep my Sabbaths; for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, that you may know that I am the LORD who sanctifies you.

zhSimplified.text: 「你要吩咐以色列人说：『你们务要守我的安息日；因为这是你我之间世世代代的证据，使你们知道我—耶和华是叫你们成为圣的。

zhTraditional.text: 「你要吩咐以色列人說：『你們務要守我的安息日；因為這是你我之間世世代代的證據，使你們知道我－耶和華是叫你們成為聖的。

en.text: You shall keep the Sabbath therefore, for it is holy to you. Everyone who profanes it shall surely be put to death; for whoever does any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

zhSimplified.text: 所以你们要守安息日，以为圣日。凡干犯这日的，必要把他治死；凡在这日做工的，必从民中剪除。

zhTraditional.text: 所以你們要守安息日，以為聖日。凡干犯這日的，必要把他治死；凡在這日做工的，必從民中剪除。

en.text: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to the LORD. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day shall surely be put to death.

zhSimplified.text: 六日要做工，但第七日是安息圣日，是向耶和华守为圣的。凡在安息日做工的，必要把他治死。』

zhTraditional.text: 六日要做工，但第七日是安息聖日，是向耶和華守為聖的。凡在安息日做工的，必要把他治死。』

en.text: Therefore the children of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, to observe the Sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.

zhSimplified.text: 故此，以色列人要世世代代守安息日为永远的约。

zhTraditional.text: 故此，以色列人要世世代代守安息日為永遠的約。

en.text: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel forever; for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.’”

zhSimplified.text: 这是我和以色列人永远的证据；因为六日之内耶和华造天地，第七日便安息舒畅。」

zhTraditional.text: 這是我和以色列人永遠的證據；因為六日之內耶和華造天地，第七日便安息舒暢。」

en.text: When he finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, he gave Moses the two tablets of the covenant, stone tablets, written with God’s finger.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华在西奈山和摩西说完了话，就把两块法版交给他，是 神用指头写的石版。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華在西奈山和摩西說完了話，就把兩塊法版交給他，是上帝用指頭寫的石版。
